body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
We're reaching out again because we were still unable to process the payment method on your account.
To avoid an interruption in your music service and a $15 reactivation fee, please update your payment information as soon as possible.
If payment isn't received, your service is scheduled to deactivate on @DeactDate@.
How to update your payment method:
Go to https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
From there:
Open Billing Details
Select @BillingGroup.Name@
Update your payment method
Go to Invoices
Select Pay
Click Charge this Card ($@Order.Total@)
Need help?
Call our Customer Support team at 586-978-4214
Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
